case folding (ß to ss), NFKC (fullwidth, ligature, roman numeral), B.1 (soft hyphen) and plain lower-casing
a code point Unicode 3.2 leaves unassigned
another code point assigned after Unicode 3.2
a right-to-left letter inside a left-to-right label breaks the bidi rule
an all right-to-left label is fine
a private-use code point is prohibited
a combining accent composes under NFKC
a query name with a non-ASCII label is nameprepped before it is matched and echoed
